architecture: Precompute exact owner/material identity outside selector hot path.
Use immutable/prevalidated per-model or per-model-slot metadata derived from exact FLVER authority.
Selector should perform only bounded O(1) lookup plus publish/fail-open.
No SHA/MTD join, global-map fallback, or repeated authentication reconstruction on selector hot path.
After implementation, run one validation comparison against the known slow baseline and known fast FLVER-bypass reference.
